title: 1 HD-T FZJ80 Conversion
ai_summary: Thread discusses planning a 1HD-T conversion into a 1997 FZJ80, focused on transmission/ECU compatibility: pre-August 1992 A442F transmissions use hydraulic/cable control while later ones are electronically controlled (ECT), and the 1997 FZJ80's combined engine/transmission computer complicates integrating an ECT-controlled diesel automatic. No confirmed completed build outcome is documented in the visible thread content.

complications.detail: Matching ECT transmission electronics to the 1997 FZJ80's combined engine/transmission ECU requires specific harness sourcing (from 1993-94 models) or an aftermarket solution (~$750)
Warning that imported used 1HD-T engines may need inspection/rebuild before use given added stress from mountain driving
